title: ageratina illita
intro: Ageratina illita, commonly known as "Cortez's ageratina" or "Mexican ageratina," is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant is rich in bioactive compounds and has been traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, coughs, and other respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Ageratina illita are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Ageratina illita include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
